svg.text: Flipper One + ALFA WiFi Adapters — Pentest Architecture
8 GB LPDDR5 · Mali-G52 GPU · 6 TOPS NPU
USB Host provides 5V power to external adapters
✅ Zero DKMS · Most stable AC chipset
Capture filters: wlan type mgt / ctl / data
All capabilities require Flipper One Debian Linux + ALFA adapter
